mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId, pr.id AS revisionId, p.current_published_revision_id AS publishedRevisionId, pr.status AS revisionStatus, p.sale_status AS saleStatus, pr.summary FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.product_id = p.id AND pr.revision_number = 1 WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND s.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id AS productId, pr.id AS revisionId, pr.title, pr.summary, pr.status AS revisionStatus, p.sale_status AS saleStatus, pr.created_at AS createdAt FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.product_id = p.id AND pr.revision_number = 1 WHERE s.owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.sql: FROM file_objects fo JOIN manifest_items mi ON mi.file_object_id = fo.id JOIN delivery_manifests dm ON dm.id = mi.manifest_id JOIN releases r ON r.id = dm.release_id JOIN packages pkg ON pkg.id = r.package_id JOIN products p ON p.id = pkg.product_id JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id WHERE s.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND fo.storage_provider = 'CLASSPATH'
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT fo.id, fo.original_filename AS filename, fo.media_type AS mediaType, fo.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, fo.storage_key AS storageKey, fo.content_sha256 AS contentSha256
ORDER BY fo.id LIMIT 50

SELECT fo.id, fo.original_filename AS filename, fo.media_type AS mediaType, fo.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, fo.storage_key AS storageKey, fo.content_sha256 AS contentSha256
AND fo.id = #{fileObjectId} ORDER BY mi.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id AS productId, pr.id AS revisionId, pkg.id AS packageId, r.id AS releaseId, dm.id AS manifestId, mi.id AS manifestItemId, pkg.name AS packageName, pkg.price_cents AS priceCents, pkg.currency, mi.file_object_id AS fileObjectId FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.id = p.current_published_revision_id AND pr.product_id = p.id JOIN packages pkg ON pkg.product_id = p.id JOIN releases r ON r.package_id = pkg.id JOIN delivery_manifests dm ON dm.release_id = r.id JOIN manifest_items mi ON mi.manifest_id = dm.id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND s.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND p.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND pr.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND pkg.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY pkg.id, r.id, mi.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO packages (product_id, name, price_cents, currency, sale_status, display_order) VALUES (#{productId}, #{packageName}, #{priceCents}, 'CNY', 'ON_SALE', 1)
INSERT INTO releases (package_id, release_number, version_label, summary, status, published_at) VALUES (#{packageId}, 1, '1.0.0', #{summary}, 'PUBLISHED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
INSERT INTO manifest_items (manifest_id, file_object_id, item_position, role, display_name) VALUES (#{manifestId}, #{fileObjectId}, 1, 'PRIMARY', #{filename})
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET sale_status = 'ON_SALE', current_published_revision_id = #{revisionId} WHERE id = #{productId} AND sale_status = 'OFF_SALE' AND current_published_revision_id IS NULL
